Jesus... I shouted at my little sister over a charger. I laughed it off. She's still not talking. 🔌

He snapped at his little sister over a charger, laughed it off, and now the house is silent.

He: Jesus... I shouted at my little sister over a charger. I laughed it off. She's still not talking. 🔌

Jesus: She closed her door softly. That was worse than slamming it.

He: It was only a charger. I had a bad day.

Jesus: The charger wasn't the thing. You know that.

He: So I just say sorry like nothing happened?

Jesus: Say it plainly. A small door opens wider than you think.

Jesus: His mercies never fail, and they are new for you today.

“Because of the loving devotion of the LORD we are not consumed, for His mercies never fail.”
Lamentations 3:22 (BSB)
